evaluate_measure.py.content_utf8:
from pathlib import Path
from importlib.metadata import version
from sidemantic.adapters.tmdl import TMDLAdapter
from sidemantic_dax import String, parse_expression
import duckdb

graph = TMDLAdapter().parse(Path.cwd())
models = graph.models.values() if isinstance(graph.models, dict) else graph.models
model, = [model for model in models if model.name == "Greeting"]
metrics = model.metrics.values() if isinstance(model.metrics, dict) else model.metrics
measure, = [metric for metric in metrics if metric.name == "Hello"]
assert measure.expression_language == "dax"
literal = parse_expression(measure.dax)
assert isinstance(literal, String) and literal == measure._dax_ast
assert measure.format == "@"
connection = duckdb.connect(":memory:")
print("sidemantic " + version("sidemantic") + "; duckdb " + duckdb.__version__ + "; SQL SELECT CAST(? AS VARCHAR)", file=__import__("sys").stderr)
result = connection.execute("SELECT CAST(? AS VARCHAR) AS greeting", [literal.value]).fetchall()
print(result[0][0])
